preparation: Joined one minute-ten feature row per match to audited duration in seconds and UTC start date by match_id. Mapped each team's hero IDs to English names with a pinned OpenDota dictionary. The source's rad_total_nw and dire_total_nw sum the five players' gold_t values at 600 seconds. Dates are stored for partitioning. The outcome, later snapshots and final match duration are excluded from the model input.
split_guidance: Assign by UTC match start year. Train on 2023–2024, validate on 2025, test on the 2026 matches through March 18 inclusive. The split measures performance on later matches. The same heroes, players or teams may recur over time.
quality_findings: One example per professional match that lasts beyond ten minutes and has timestamp-aligned telemetry.
Dataset v3 removes 1,849 matches with shifted or irregular economic timestamps from v2.
Hero names identify the draft. Their list order is a stable identifier order, not pick order.

remaining_match_seconds.target_name: remaining match duration after ten minutes
remaining_match_seconds.instruction: At the ten-minute mark of this professional Dota 2 match, estimate how many more seconds will elapse before the match ends.
remaining_match_seconds.field_description: radiant_heroes and dire_heroes list the five heroes drafted by each side. radiant_earned_gold and dire_earned_gold give the total gold earned by each side through minute ten.
